#486 r1 judgment (rvw_20261112T101600Z_d80308bb): ACCEPT A take-back after session close (sol-F, haiku, minimax-F, deepseek) -> live.takeBackDraft to draft or draft store; B late-settled cancel restores once (sol-F, grok-F) -> _editing settled from cancel, check, every ledger read; C spaces draft kept (luna); D preview ellipsis (luna); E no take-back during a send, restore deferred after send (haiku); F own cancelled entry hidden (haiku, deepseek); J tests (step); K takeBack fails closed (step); I covered by K. REJECT G (deepseek): pre-existing, OpenCode drops steered input from pending. REJECT H (deepseek): same 20% cap as old inbox, reverse scroll keeps field. No frontier position rejected. Async/persistence fixes: re-review.

#486 r2 judgment: ACCEPT all themes (store append race; deferred-during-send lost on close; refresh-before-takeBack drops intent; concurrent takeBack; unsettled take-back lost on close/reopen; stale entry double restore; take-back before saved draft read; onTapHint gate; cancelPending notice; _preview bounded; composer text doc; tests). Root cause: in-memory _editing. Redesign: PromptOutbox.cancel(takeBack:) durably marks the ledger record takenBack; a live composer restores cancelled+takenBack entries into live.draft (sync, only when not sending and draft settled), then dismisses them; no store writes after close; a reopened session restores. No frontier position rejected. Gate on 2cc9eb0f stopped (moot).

#486 r3 judgment: ACCEPT eviction skips takenBack (sol-F, grok-F, haiku, deepseek); dismiss only after draftKeeps (flush + saved draft ends with text) (sol-F, grok-F, haiku, luna); never re-restore in a view, entry removed from cache after dismiss (sol-F, haiku, deepseek, minimax-F); failed dismiss: next view skips append when draft already ends with text, retries dismiss (sol-F, minimax-F, step, luna); take-back on already-cancelled record persists flag (minimax-F, haiku); notice none on takenBack check; tests (step). Also gate fix: post-send restore timer only when owed. REJECT haiku reopen-during-old-send (4 coincident conditions, same window as typing) and luna two composers (one live controller per session). sol-F's durable consumed-id idea met by draftKeeps + endsWith idempotency, finding accepted.

#486 r4 judgment: ACCEPT endsWith skip and read-back removed (append once per command per view by identity; sol-F, grok-F, minimax-F, haiku, deepseek, step); hand-off = flush draft then dismiss, so batched restores all dismiss (sol-F, grok-F, haiku, luna); eviction exempts only cancelled take-backs, delivered ones evictable (sol-F, grok-F, haiku, luna, step); BEHAVIOR wording (step). Accepted tradeoff: a ledger that cannot forget after the draft write adds the text once more in a later view, never loses it. REJECT haiku flag-write failure after explicit X (storage failure after a deliberate cancel). No frontier position rejected.

#486 r5 judgment (5/8 approve incl. grok-F, minimax-F): ACCEPT sol-F cross-view claim (static _handingOff by session+command; a view opened meanwhile leaves the take-back to the handing view); ACCEPT luna/haiku flush awaits in-flight writes (SessionDraftStore._writing); ACCEPT deepseek/minimax-F BEHAVIOR wording. REJECT haiku refused-draft and process-death windows: declared tradeoffs stated in code and BEHAVIOR (refused draft stays on screen like typed text; at most one more copy). No frontier position rejected.

#486 r6 judgment (5/8 approve incl. grok-F, minimax-F): ACCEPT sol-F/haiku/deepseek: a view that finds a take-back claimed by another view leaves it for good (_leftToOthers: no append, no dismiss, line hidden), test fires a live change after the release; ACCEPT haiku static claim reset hook (clearHandOffs in test setUp); ACCEPT step hide line in skipping view. REJECT haiku per-session flush wait (delays only, no correctness impact). Gate on eca0d6c1 stopped (tree changed).

#486 r7 judgment: CONVERGED (7/8 approve, all frontier approve). REJECT haiku two-interactive-composers residual: the workspace keeps one live controller per session (a closed view is disposed), so a left view whose draft predates the write is not reachable in practice; documented residual. No fixes; loop ends.
